result.title: Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data
result.comment: 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text
result.summary: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Spatial-Zero：无需外部数据，由 proposer 指定物体配置与问题、Coder 将其转为可执行场景程序并渲染多视图图像与显式几何，Geometric Oracle 校验可见性与答案唯一性并导出标签来监督 Solver，同时用验证结果反馈难度以迭代自演化；在六个空间推理基准、三个 VLM 骨干上均有一致提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 VLM 对度量距离、三维关系与视角几何的表示与训练问题，其「可执行场景程序 + oracle 校验标签 + 难度反馈」为视觉证据筛选与训练监督分配提供了可供核查的线索，但未涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用。
